packageDefects.package: @hawiyah/vanilla (and by the same specification React, Vue, Angular)
packageDefects.what: An expanded tree item is named by aria-labelledby pointing at its label span (spec-navigation-menus-shell: the treeitem is named by its label alone, so the toggle's aria-label stays out of the name). axe-core 4.14 rule label-content-name-mismatch (WCAG 2.5.3) then fails, because the visible text of the li includes the nested group's child items, which are not in the name. Before the milestone vanilla wrote no aria-labelledby and the check passed. The specification and the axe rule conflict; the resolution (e.g. keep aria-labelledby and treat the hit as a false positive with owner sign-off, or drop aria-labelledby and remove the toggle from the name computation another way) is a design decision across the four adapters, not a small certain fix.

Arabic run passes only because axe returns 'incomplete' for the Arabic text.
